# Ever Roll Fund

> Ever Roll Fund, Inc. is a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt nonprofit (EIN 42-3511117, exempt effective June 25, 2026; Florida Registration #CH85847) that makes equipment grants for people with spinal cord injuries in the United States. Grants cover the gap between what insurance pays and what mobility and accessibility equipment costs. Grants are paid directly to the equipment manufacturer or DME supplier, never to the individual. Applying is free.

## Key facts
- Who qualifies: people with a spinal cord injury (traumatic or non-traumatic, any level, complete or incomplete) living in the U.S., D.C., or U.S. territories, with a specific item and price quote, who have already been through insurance or have no insurance.
- What is funded: manual and power wheelchairs, power-assist wheels, cushions and seating, standing frames, transfer equipment, shower and commode chairs, pressure-relief surfaces, adaptive sports equipment, vehicle modifications and hand controls, home accessibility modifications, communication and computer access technology. New, used, or refurbished.
- No tax returns or proof of income required. Online application takes about 20 minutes. Most applicants hear back within 30 days.
- Family members, caregivers, and clinicians can apply on someone's behalf.
- Contact: Kortlund Natterstad, Co-Founder & Director - kortlund@everrollfund.org - 305-414-2269
